name: Gradient Text
description: Inline text filled with an animated multi-color gradient, with three gradient styles, optional glow, gradient pill border, hover pause and pointer-following highlight.
contents: Wrapper span with gradient-clipped children text
Optional blurred glow copy of the text behind it
Optional gradient pill border around the text
behavior: Gradient animates continuously via requestAnimationFrame, back and forth or looping
Animation pauses when scrolled out of view
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing the animation
Can pull the gradient toward the pointer with spring smoothing while hovered
editableByProps: Text content, gradient colors, speed, angle or direction, scale
Gradient style through variant, back-and-forth or looping through yoyo
Glow strength from 0 to 1, border toggle and width
Pause on hover and pointer following

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pill border shape or padding
needsCodeEdit.where: The showBorder class string on the root span
The blur(0.3em) filter class on the glow span
The stiffness constant inside the tick function
VARIANTS constant and the branches in the paint function

fixed: Requires Tailwind CSS with arbitrary value support
Client component, needs a browser with IntersectionObserver
Speed has a minimum of 0.2 and scale is clamped to 1 to 6
Colors with a single entry are duplicated, so the gradient is flat
Border is always a pill shape (rounded-full) when enabled
Glow renders only when glow is above 0

options.look: Classic repeating linear gradient sliding across the text
options.useWhen: Headline word in a hero that needs a clean color sweep

options.look: Soft radial color blobs drifting over the text like liquid
options.useWhen: Brand or AI product title that should feel organic and fluid

options.look: Repeating conic gradient swaying around a point below the text
options.useWhen: Eye-catching badge or highlight word in a CTA or feature callout
